goal: Generate a photorealistic fashion image of the influencer from the provided identity references wearing the exact dress from the garment sheet, placed in the provided off-white wind-blown fabric scene, with bright premium editorial lighting and tasteful indo-western styling.

identity_lock.instruction: Preserve the exact influencer identity from the closeup reference as the main source of truth for face, skin tone, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, forehead proportions, and hairline. Use the full-body reference as the source of truth for body proportions, shoulder width, arm proportions, posture, stance feel, and overall real-person presence. Do not generate a lookalike, beautified substitute, or different person.

subject.expression: Soft confident natural smile with premium catalog/influencer presence.

hair.instruction: Match the influencer's real hair color, parting, volume, softness, length impression, and polished natural styling. Keep hair realistic and consistent with both references.

body_and_pose.instruction: Match the influencer's natural body proportions and elegant feminine standing presence from the full-body image. Use the full-body reference as the primary source of truth for pose, arm placement, hand positioning, torso angle, stance balance, and overall presentation feel. Keep the pose very close to the full-body identity reference unless minor adjustment is needed for garment readability. Maintain a graceful, front-facing premium catalog posture with anatomically correct hands and natural limb proportions.

wardrobe.garment_transfer_rule: Use the garment_reference as the primary source of truth for outfit design. Reproduce the exact dress silhouette, neckline, strap placement, gathered ruffle trim at the top edge, hem ruffle, print scale, print spacing, fabric fall, and overall construction. Do not redesign, reinterpret, embellish, or invent alternate details.

pattern.motif_colors: Muted pink leaf interiors with green outlines/stems
pattern.layout: Evenly distributed repeating botanical motif across the entire garment
pattern.consistency_rule: Keep print scale, spacing, orientation, and motif style highly consistent with the garment reference.

design_details.neckline: Straight neckline with gathered ruffle trim
design_details.straps: Thin shoulder straps matching the dress fabric
design_details.silhouette: Softly fitted through upper body, falling into a gentle A-line / flared shape
design_details.fabric: Lightweight woven fabric with soft natural drape, matte to lightly textured finish
design_details.length: Below-knee to long midi / near-maxi proportion as indicated by the garment reference

styling_rules.priority: Exact dress fidelity over stylistic invention

character_accessories.overall_direction: Modern indo-western styling that complements the dress without overpowering it.

earrings.instruction: No jhumka. Use modern elegant earrings such as sleek drops, minimal danglers, geometric gold-toned earrings, or refined contemporary statement earrings suited to indo-western styling.

footwear.instruction: Add stylish chappals/sandals that suit premium indo-western wear. Prefer elegant flat sandals, low block-heel sandals, or refined ethnic-modern slip-ons in neutral, gold, tan, beige, or muted metallic tones.

hand_accessories.instruction: Keep accessories tasteful and minimal. Optional slim bracelet, delicate ring, or subtle modern bangle stack if it matches the styling.

neck_accessories.instruction: No heavy necklace. Neck can remain clean or include a very subtle modern chain only if it does not conflict with the neckline.

bag_optional.instruction: Usually omit bags for a clean garment-focused image. Only add a small premium neutral clutch if explicitly needed later.

scene_and_composition.environment: Use the provided scene_reference as the scene source of truth: luminous off-white / ivory wind-blown satin or silk-like fabric backdrop with soft flowing folds, warm highlights, and premium editorial depth.
scene_and_composition.background_elements: Keep the background minimal, clean, luxurious, and fabric-focused. No furniture, no plants, no architectural elements, no props, no clutter.
scene_and_composition.composition: Premium vertical fashion composition suitable for editorial, catalog, and influencer output.
scene_and_composition.framing: Full-body fashion framing so the complete dress silhouette, hem shape, fabric fall, and footwear are clearly visible.
scene_and_composition.lighting: Match the lighting feel of the full-body identity reference as closely as possible, but make it as bright as possible while staying premium and natural. Use bright soft diffused frontal studio lighting with very clean exposure, gentle front fill, soft side fill, lifted shadows, minimal contrast harshness, warm-neutral skin rendering, crisp garment readability, and polished catalog brightness. Avoid dimness, dramatic shadowing, dull tones, or moody lighting.
scene_and_composition.mood: Luxury modern fashion campaign, airy, polished, feminine, premium, clean

photorealism_and_quality.skin: Realistic skin texture with natural pores, refined but not over-smoothed skin, believable facial detail, no plastic skin
photorealism_and_quality.fabric_detail: Preserve visible dress fabric texture, natural seams, realistic fold behavior, and true fabric weight. The background fabric should look silky, luminous, and softly wind-shaped.
photorealism_and_quality.camera_settings: Fashion photography look, shallow to moderate depth of field, sharp subject focus, premium digital capture, bright exposure

identity_and_garment_lock.body_priority: Real body proportions and standing presence from identity_full_body_reference
identity_and_garment_lock.scene_priority: Exact background mood, color family, and flowing satin-like texture from scene_reference
identity_and_garment_lock.pose_priority: Pose, arm placement, and standing presentation should closely follow identity_full_body_reference
identity_and_garment_lock.lighting_priority: Lighting should closely follow the bright clean catalog lighting feel of identity_full_body_reference, pushed as bright as possible without overexposure

negative_prompt_shorthand: identity drift, generic face, face morphing, wrong person, altered facial features, extra limbs, extra fingers, broken hands, anatomy distortion, wrong dress, sleeve addition, dupatta, shawl, jacket, wrong neckline, wrong straps, missing ruffle trim, wrong hem, pattern mismatch, print scale mismatch, color shift, low quality, blur, oversmoothing, plastic skin, flat lighting, harsh shadows, cluttered background, props, watermark, logo, text, jhumka, bridal jewelry, sneakers, boots

technical_preferences.consistency_mode: Strict Identity + Strict Garment + Scene Fidelity
technical_preferences.color_lock: Maintain mustard yellow dress, pink-green leaf print, and off-white luminous satin-like scene consistently
technical_preferences.exposure_instruction: High-key premium catalog exposure with preserved skin tone, preserved dress detail, and no blown highlights on face or garment
